justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/pool/TypePool.java (around lines 6990-7340). The target is not a small single-purpose class: the abstract LazyAnnotationValue base only delegates 7 operations (getState, filter, resolve, load, hashCode, equals, toString), and the same block also contains 5 nested concrete/helper classes (ForMismatchedType, ForTypeValue, ForAnnotationValue, ForEnumerationValue, ForArray) that implement separate resolution paths for type, annotation, enum, and array annotation values. That concentration of multiple distinct responsibilities in one nested class cluster indicates insufficient modularization.
